title: Navy intelligence visits Frances Swan
summary: Grant Cameron tells of Navy intelligence visits Frances Swan, about 1954-1959 at Eliot, Maine, and summarises it without a named source. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: and then Navy intelligence picks up on this woman and they go and visit her in 1954

plain: Grant Cameron, a researcher of UFO history, tells of a woman named Frances Swan who lived in Eliot, Maine, in the 1950s. He says Navy intelligence took notice of her and visited her in 1954, a story he links to an FBI and Navy intelligence document and to a man named Wilbert Smith. If true, it would show the military taking a private citizen's UFO-related claims seriously enough to check on her.
